description: This file defines a Flutter widget called RideBottomSheet, which displays ride details such as distance, fare, payment options, and a request ride button. It interacts with the RideState provider for state management and includes UI elements with styling and user interaction logic.

classes.name: RideBottomSheet
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays ride information such as distance, fare, and provides options for payment method and ride request.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ride bottom sheet, displaying ride details and interaction buttons.

methods.name: _showPaymentMethod
methods.description: Displays a modal bottom sheet for selecting payment methods.

methods.name: _onRequestRide
methods.description: Handles the ride request action, updates ride state, shows confirmation message, and dismisses the bottom sheet.
